name: Pandan
hook: Pandan stunted? Give it more water, not less.

steps.title: Bright light, some shade
steps.tip: Give it less than 4 hours of direct sun, or 6–8 hours of bright, indirect light. Light shade suits it.

steps.title: Keep it moist, even wet
steps.tip: It loves water and grows in waterlogged ground. It survives drought, but dry soil stunts its growth.

steps.title: Loamy soil, 10 cm deep
steps.tip: Its roots are shallow, so it grows well in a pot. Fill it with loamy soil at least 10 cm deep.

steps.title: Keep it warm
steps.tip: Pandan is a tropical plant. It is too tender to grow outdoors in cool climates.

steps.title: Pot rooted side shoots
steps.tip: Once a side shoot has its own roots, cut or twist it off at the base of the parent and pot it.

steps.title: Watch for mealybugs
steps.tip: Mealybugs, aphids and mites attack stressed or pot-bound plants. Cut off infested leaves and fix the cause.

outro: Plenty of water, soft light and warmth keep the leaves coming.
